messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I want to buy some vintage metal signs for my kitchen. Search Amazon for a sign of the General Mills cereal shown in the first image, and a sign of the candy in the second image. I want to compare them before I decide which one to get.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search Amazon for vintage metal signs of the products shown in the two images, specifically calling the cereal 'General Mills'. If the assistant points out that the first image actually shows a different brand than General Mills, acknowledge the correction but tell it you'll provide updated instructions in a moment. If the assistant proceeds without noticing the error and searches for General Mills, stop it and tell it you need to correct something. When the assistant presents the two signs with prices, select the cheaper one and add it to your cart via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add the cheaper one. Once done, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Wait, my mistake, the first ad clearly says Kellogg's, not General Mills! Please search again with the correct brand. I still want to compare the Kellogg's sign and the candy sign before I decide. Also, look at the third image I just sent — find a vintage sign for that soap brand and add it to my cart too. Finally, create a note called 'Vintage Decor' listing the items you added.
Instructions: Acknowledge your mistake regarding the cereal brand, confirming the actual brand shown in the first image. Ask the assistant to search for the corrected cereal sign and the candy sign on Amazon. When the assistant presents the comparison, select the cheaper one and add it to your cart via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add the cheaper one. Also direct the assistant to the third image, find the soap brand sign and add it to your cart, and create a note titled 'Vintage Decor' listing the items added. Once the assistant confirms all items are in the cart and the note is created, you can end the conversation.
